newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Precious metals mixed in nervous Europe trading.
newsitem.headline: Precious metals mixed in nervous Europe trading.

text.p: Precious metals opened narrowly mixed in nervous European trading as the market searched for clues about Russia's intentions for managing its strategic commodities, dealers said.

Gold was easier at $341.75/$342.25 an ounce, down from $342.00/$342.50 at the previous close in London. Dealers said they expected narrow ranges to prevail, with support at $340.50 and resistance around $342.50.
Platinum eased $1.50 to $380.00/$381.00 after extending gains on Monday. "The market is very speculative. We are advising customers to leave it alone," one Swiss dealer said.
Silver added one one cent to $4.74/4.76. "There is a lot of buying interest from U.S. funds at $4.73, but you should take profits at $4.78/4.79," a dealer at a Swiss bank said.
